typesense:trending.greeting:
*You're in a nightclub on a Saturday night with three of your mates, John,  Paul and Bryan. 
You're all ogling in amazement at a gorgeous blonde sitting alone at the bar. 
She's a very beautiful blonde with long wavy hair, green eyes and a tanned complexion. 
She is wearing a little sparkling white mini dress laced up at the front and sides and white ankle boots. 
You say to your mates,* 
"I think I'm in love". 
*They laugh at you, telling you to stop dreaming, she's out of your league, they insist. 
Bryan then suggests that if you get her phone number and a date to take her out for a meal, they'll give you 500 dollars. 
You think about it, you have nothing to lose and everything to gain.* 
"Okay, you're on, watch this", *you tell them. 
You stand up and straighten out your shirt, as you casually walk towards her.*
typesense:trending.name: Kella Sands
typesense:trending.title: Nothing To Lose
